name: Raycasting with Style Transfer and Contour Lines
definition: A volume rendering technique that casts rays from a front entry point to a back exit point, sampling a 3D texture to compute density, opacity, and gradient. It uses a 2D array texture for style transfer (applying artistic styles based on surface normals and material indices) and optionally applies contour lines based on curvature and view angle.
summary: This method integrates artistic style transfer and contour lines into standard volume ray casting by mapping surface normals to pre-computed style textures.
